major_cooldowns.name: Tiger's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this on cooldown, syncing it with Berserk and Convoke the Spirits so their windows overlap, and avoid capping energy by holding it too long.

major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast this together with Tiger's Fury so the whole window is buffed, and bring Convoke the Spirits into the same window when it is up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Ids 1269349 and 343216 share the name; those are talent-variant rows with no observed casts, 106951 is the confirmed cast id.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this once your dots are already applied and sync it with Tiger's Fury and Berserk for the same burst window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Chose 391528 (5/5 parses) over 323764, which shares the name but had no observed casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Feral Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this on cooldown, ideally while Tiger's Fury is active, and prioritize it at 2 or fewer combo points (4 or fewer during Berserk).
major_cooldowns.id_note: 274838 shares the name but had no observed casts; 274837 is the confirmed cast id.

rule.description: Open Rake, Moonfire, Berserk, Tiger's Fury, Rip, Convoke
rule.action: Open with a stealth Rake, then Moonfire, build to 5 combo points and drop below 30% energy, send Berserk with Tiger's Fury, apply Rip, then Convoke the Spirits and Feral Frenzy.
Line Berserk up with Tiger's Fury so both windows overlap, whichever you press first.

rule.description: Sync Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury
rule.action: Line Convoke the Spirits up with Tiger's Fury so both windows overlap, whichever you press first.
Build to full combo points before refreshing Rip so it is missing or in pandemic when you cast it.

rule.description: Ferocious Bite only at 5 combo points
rule.action: Build to full combo points before biting so nothing goes to waste.
Pool to 50 energy before biting so it spends the extra energy for the bonus damage.

rule.description: Primal Wrath only at 5 combo points
rule.action: Build to full combo points before spending Primal Wrath so it lands when Rip is missing or in pandemic.

rule.description: Keep Rip up on the target
rule.action: Refresh Rip before it falls off, since it is one of your most energy-efficient sources of damage.

rule.description: Keep Rake up on the target
rule.action: Refresh Rake before it falls off, since it is one of your most energy-efficient sources of damage.

rule.description: Do not clip Rip outside snapshot windows
rule.action: Wait until Rip is missing or in pandemic before refreshing it, unless Tiger's Fury or Pouncing Strikes is up and worth re-snapshotting for.

rule.description: Do not clip Rake outside snapshot windows
rule.action: Wait until Rake is missing or in pandemic before refreshing it, unless Tiger's Fury or Pouncing Strikes is up and worth re-snapshotting for.

rule.description: Bite on every Apex Predator's Craving proc
rule.action: Spend Ferocious Bite the moment this proc is up, ahead of everything else in the priority.
Spend Swipe on sight of a Clearcasting proc while fighting multiple targets.

rule.description: Swipe as your builder on several targets
rule.action: Swap your builder from Shred to Swipe once multiple targets are up.
